rule: Client-side routers of crawled single-page themes (25 Oct 2026): a crawled TanStack Start app was built to live at a site root, so under /<theme>/ (and /wales/<theme>/, /argentina/<theme>/) its router read the path as an unknown page and showed "Not Found". Each entry tells that theme's router its base path at run time (runtime.js sets window.__cedwynSec before the bundle runs). Same schema as ingredients.json; file may be a glob so a re-hashed crawl still matches; a find that is not present is reported, never fatal. — Sion's Tab agent
